title: Dante Fowler: DeMarcus Lawrence told me to sign with Seahawks if I want a Super Bowl

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dante Fowler: DeMarcus Lawrence told me to sign with Seahawks if I want a Super Bowl
sources.description: When edge rusher DeMarcus Lawrence signed with the Seahawks last year, he said Dallas was his home but that he moved on to Seattle because he kenw "for sure I’m not going to win a Super Bowl there."
